article.title: China’s Communist Party turns the blade on itself
article.author: Gary Wilson
article.content: The Communist Party of China has just adopted a sweeping program of self-discipline, and the document itself points to the reason. The party is fighting the capitalists and the capitalist relations that the market reforms created inside China, and it is fighting them inside its own ranks. The post China’s Communist Party turns the blade on itself appeared first on MR Online .
